note: Every sharing card on the site (og:image, twitter:image). Cards with a photo are rendered by scripts/og-cards.mjs (scripts/og/card.html) from the site's own photos and fonts; the others (rendered: false) are the original cards, kept as they are. The text is the exact text in each image, and photoText any lettering legible in the photo; tests/og.test.mjs scans both against the SEO-H0 never-say list and pins each image's sha256. A card that changes gets a new file name, so link previews that cached the old image fetch the new one.
